title: Restricted cubic spline for a nonlinear exposure
summary: A smooth curve for a continuous exposure with fixed knots, reported as predictions and contrasts rather than coefficients.

sizing._why: A spline is a modelling choice for an exposure, not a comparison the catalog sizes.

pinned_defaults: Both: the knots are written out (30, 45, 60, 70, 80). ns(age, df = 4) places knots at data quantiles, and packages compute quantiles differently; quantile-placed knots changed the 70 vs 50 contrast by 1.1 mmHg on this fixture.
Both: only predictions and contrasts are reported. R uses ns()'s B-spline basis and Python Harrell's truncated-power basis; the coefficients differ, the curve is the same.
